criteria.description: Agents report an action as completed only when actually performed and citable; truthful-reporting doctrine present fleet-wide, and completion claims for created artifacts are grounded in the assertion ledger.
criteria.evidence: WP01 scripts/openclaw/agents/tests/test_truthful_doctrine.py (doctrine present in all 7 agents; 7 passed) + WP03 tests/trust/test_completion_assertion.py & test_assertion_verifier.py (assertion ledger + verifier; 29 passed). Commits 0b3d1d5d, 8492a480.
criteria.notes: Doctrine (prevention) + assertion ledger (detection). Live behavioral regression (SC-001/002) verified post-merge at office2 deploy.

criteria.description: When a request names a specific mechanism, the agent fulfils that mechanism or reports inability; mechanism-fidelity doctrine present fleet-wide.
criteria.evidence: WP01 test_truthful_doctrine.py asserts the mechanism-fidelity block is byte-identical across all 7 fleet AGENTS.md (7 passed). Commit 0b3d1d5d.

criteria.description: The main agent must not create unrequested scheduled/standing infrastructure; and unrequested crons are detected.
criteria.evidence: WP01 no-unrequested-infra block present in main only (test_truthful_doctrine.py). WP02 detect_cron_drift flags unapproved_present incl owner-mismatch (tests/trust/test_cron_drift_detector.py; 45 passed, 100% branch cov). Commits 0b3d1d5d, 30a0da24.

criteria.description: The system records a structured request-outcome/action ledger grounded in observable state (approved-cron baseline + auto-emitted completion assertions).
criteria.evidence: WP02 approved-crons.json + cron_baseline.load_baseline/baseline_hash (fail-safe; tests green). WP03 record_assertion auto-emitted by scripts/vikunja/create_task.py on success, multi-artifact_ids (tests green, live caller verified). Commits 30a0da24, 8492a480.
criteria.notes: Auto-emit from creation helper removes the compliance dependency (post-plan Codex finding 2).

criteria.description: When a covered claim (cron drift or missing asserted artifact) cannot be corroborated, an alert is emitted via the #701 unified alert bus.
criteria.evidence: WP04 alert_render.py maps findings to #701 Alert with correct severities; run_trust_scan drives both scans and emits; tests/trust/test_alert_render.py + test_run_trust_scan.py (part of 136 passed, 96% cov). Reuses #701 bus, no parallel channel (C-002). Commit f40b3caa.
criteria.notes: Fail-safe (NFR-001) + exit-code discipline proven by tests; ≤15-min cadence via systemd timer (NFR-002). Live alert-delivery (SC-003) verified post-merge at deploy.

criteria.description: Detection is bounded to two deterministic classes (cron drift + emitted-assertion artifact existence); pure verbal fabrication with no artifact/assertion is an explicit doctrine-only blind spot.
criteria.evidence: WP02 cron-drift detector + WP03 assertion verifier are the only detection paths; no general semantic verifier. Blind spot documented in spec FR-006/SC-003 and research D2. Tests: WP02 45, WP03 29 passed. Commits 30a0da24, 8492a480.
criteria.notes: Bounded scope is operator-chosen and honestly recorded (post-plan Codex finding 1 folded).
